title: We are live! The Orientation Days 2026 website is up
excerpt: From today, all Orientation Days information lives in one place.
body: Welcome! This is the official Orientation Days 2026 website. Here you will find the schedule, key links, the FAQ and contact details for the organisers.
The site will grow as preparations continue. Check back regularly and follow the key announcements on Facebook.

title: Save the date: 1–3 October 2026
excerpt: Orientation Days take place on the first weekend of the semester. Check which days apply to you.
body: Full-time Bachelor's students attend on Thursday and Friday, 1–2 October. Master's students attend on Thursday, 1 October. Part-time students join online on Saturday, 3 October.
The full breakdown is in the About section, and the detailed plan is in the Schedule.
